title: energy.drift event (concept drift and distribution shift monitoring)
description: Continuous monitoring signal for statistical concept drift over model forecast errors or telemetry distribution. A confirmed drift signal triggers dynamic model re-evaluation.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run, shared across all topics.

meter_id.description: Kafka message key. uci-001 is the real series; uci-002.. are load replicas.

event_time.description: Window start time at which drift was evaluated or confirmed (UTC).

drift_detected.description: True if statistical test confirms significant concept drift.

drift_score.description: Computed drift test statistic (e.g. cut ratio |mu0 - mu1| / epsilon_cut or test statistic).

mean_error_before.description: Mean absolute forecast error of pre-drift subwindow (W0).

mean_error_after.description: Mean absolute forecast error of post-drift subwindow (W1).

p_value.description: Empirical or asymptotic p-value if applicable.

window_size.description: Current effective sample count or window length in the detector.

trigger_event_id.description: event_id of the incoming hourly or prediction event triggering this evaluation.

trigger_replay_time_ms.description: replay_time_ms of trigger event for end-to-end latency tracking.

emit_time_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch-ms when drift monitor emitted this record.
